 NYPD floods scene after body is found in bag on Brooklyn street 
 Few details were immediately available. Here's what we know so far. 
 By Erica Byfield and Jonathan Dienst • 
 Published 5 hours ago • 
 Updated 2 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Authorities are investigating after a body was found in a bag on a Brooklyn street Thursday, according to law enforcement sources familiar with the case.
 Chopper 4 showed a heavy police presence at the East 91st Street scene in Canarsie, where the body was found. Neighbors say police have video showing someone drop the bag in front of a church overnight. 
 They say several hours later, a man known to collect scrap metal was seen pulling the bag down the street. He discovered the body. It is believed to be that of a man between 50 and 60 years old, police say.

 No other details on the circumstances were immediately available.
